title.zh: 规定将 Guiuan 市镇中学改设为名为 Guiuan 国立中学的国立中学并为其拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Providing for the Conversion of the Guiuan Municipal High School Into a National High School to Be Known as the Guiuan National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Providing for the Conversion of the Guiuan Municipal High School Into a National High School to Be Known as the Guiuan National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trường Trung học Guiuan Đô thị thành Trường Trung học Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Guiuan Quốc gia, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Guiuan เทศบาล เป็น โรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแห่งชาติในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Guiuan แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Sekolah Menengah Guiuan Kotamadya menjadi Sekolah Menengah Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Guiuan Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menukar status Sekolah Menengah Guiuan Perbandaran kepada Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Guiuan Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1997/ra_8400_1997.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Guiuan Municipal High School in the Municipality of Guiuan, Province of Eastern Samar is hereby converted into a national high school to be known as the Guiuan National High School.
All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Guiuan Municipal High School are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Guiuan National High School.
The Secretary of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue the necessary rules and memorandum for the proper implementation of the provisions of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
